items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But he was with Duke almost all the time.

ctx.x: Because I know, when Mexico lived out here, he had tuberculosis or something and he was in the Veterans Hospital. Duke used to get him out of the hospital, and he would stay with Duke at the Watkins Hotel.
Oh? I don't remember that. But he was with Duke almost all the time.
Yeah, he used to drive Duke around out here.
